column34: All India Pincode Directory through Webservice which contains all the pincode list across India with relevant information like Circle Name, Region Name, Division Name, Office Name, Pincode, Office Type, Delivery, District, State Name. Postal Index Number (PIN or PIN Code) is a 6 digit code of Post Office numbering used by India Post. The PIN was introduced on August 15, 1972. There are 9 PIN regions in the country. The first 8 are geographical regions and the digit 9 is reserved for the Army Postal Service. The first digit indicates one of the regions. The first 2 digits together indicate the sub region or one of the postal circles. The first 3 digits together indicate a sorting or revenue district. The last 3 digits refer to the delivery Post Office.

Data update frequency: how frequent the data is published to the platform.For a daily temporal resolution, "P1D"^^xsd:duration. Where:

P = period prefix
1D = 1 day

The pattern for xsd:duration is:

P (required prefix)
nY = years
nM = months
nD = days
T (separator for time components)
nH = hours
nM = minutes
nS = seconds

Examples:

P1D = 1 day
P7D = 7 days (weekly)
PT1H = 1 hour (note the T separator)
P1Y = 1 year

The data are collected and transmitted automatically from field instruments without human intervention. As the data are live, occasional abnormal or missing values may appear due to episodic pollution events or instrumental errors. This dataset supports environmental assessment, urban air quality management, and research on pollution trends.

column32: DCAT provides the dcat:inSeries property to link a dataset to its parent dataset series. Without this explicit link, the relationship between individual datasets and their series would be ambiguous. Series dataset can be linked using prev or next latest dataset (via dcat:first and dcat:last) or first and last dataset in the series.
